summary: Iteration 2: Tested the brand-new daily missions + XP/level system end-to-end. Wrote 11 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_missions.py — all 11 PASS against the live backend. Verified determinism for day=1 (fert_2, irrigate_3, contract_1 with correct instance_ids), GET /api/missions and /api/game/state shape, progression bumps via irrigate/fertilize/buy water, claim flow with exact reward shape & level math (xp=40, xp_for_next=100, xp_to_next=60, progress_pct=40.0), and the three error cases (already claimed → 400, not completed → 400, unknown id → 404). Frontend tested via Playwright: sidebar 'Missions' link present (data-testid='nav-missions'), Topbar 'Niv. 1 · 0 XP' badge present (data-testid='topbar-level'), Dashboard renders missions-panel with 3 mission cards, /missions page renders the title 'Missions quotidiennes', progression card, mission panel, and 5 cosmetic tiers. Triggered 3 irrigations via API, clicked 'Réclamer' on the irrigate_3 mission, toast appeared with '+40 XP · +80 €', the mission card switched to 'Récompense obtenue' and the topbar badge updated to 'Niv. 1 · 40 XP'.
critical_code_review_comments: game_logic.update_mission_progress overrides m['completed']=False for reverse missions on every bump, which is the correct behaviour because passive missions are only resolved at end-of-day via _finalize_passive_missions. Confirmed by tests.
server.buy_resource only bumps water_purchased for water; non-water resources just call update_mission_progress. OK but `_bump_stat` would be cleaner if it always refreshed via single path. Minor.

server.claim_mission re-derives level_info AFTER awarding xp and adds any cosmetic for level >= threshold. Good. However the response 'level' is computed BEFORE the cosmetic is appended, which is fine (cosmetic is in rewards.cosmetic). No bug.
Mongo _id is correctly excluded everywhere ({'_id': 0} projection in find_one/find).

Auto-tick is still hot (10 s = 1 game day). Long-running test sessions or slow browsers may roll the day mid-test, which invalidates the day-1 deterministic missions. Backend tests sidestep this by calling /api/game/reset just before each scenario. Worth keeping in mind for future testers.
seed_data_creation: Each backend test calls POST /api/game/reset to land on day=1 with deterministic missions (fert_2, irrigate_3, contract_1). Frontend test does the same via page.request before exercising the UI.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend uses single global save (GAME_ID='global'). Auto-tick = 1 in-game day per 10 real seconds, so always POST /api/game/reset right before mission-dependent assertions. Day-1 missions are guaranteed to be {fert_2, irrigate_3, contract_1}. Instance ids follow 'mission-{day}-{mission_id}'. The frontend's Toast lives outside the main viewport so screenshot-asserts on the toast may miss it; instead assert on the mission card text 'Récompense obtenue' and topbar-level XP value (both update synchronously after refresh()). Previous backend_test.py (16 cases) is still relevant and orthogonal to test_missions.py — run both together: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v.
rca of the issue: No bugs found. Mission seeding, progression bumps, claim flow, level math, and cosmetic-unlock skeleton all behave per spec.
